description: This source file is a PHP script for configuring wireless network settings in a web UI, including fetching current configuration via SNMP-like keys, managing WPS settings, WLAN modes, channels, security settings, and handling UI controls and AJAX interactions.

methods.name: update_Wi_Fi_control_list
methods.description: AJAX-triggered function to update Wi-Fi control list based on selected SSID.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX POST to update wireless configuration with provided JSON config object.

methods.name: show_extch
methods.description: Displays specific extension channel options based on selected channel.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates new device name and MAC address fields before adding.

methods.name: adjust_row
methods.description: Reindexes and styles table rows for filter or auto tables.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new row to a specified table with provided device name and MAC address.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Removes a specified row from the filter table after confirmation.

methods.name: add_auto
methods.description: Copies a row from auto-table into filter table.

methods.name: add_manual
methods.description: Triggers validation and then adds a device to filter list.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves current filter list configuration via AJAX.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Saves main wireless settings (mode, channel, power, etc.) via AJAX.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves radio/WPS enable/disable state via AJAX.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Initiates WPS pairing process via AJAX.

methods.name: pair_cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing via AJAX.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays band steering history in a virtual dialog.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Fetches and displays band steering history logs via AJAX.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering configuration parameters via AJAX.
